claims.text: This excerpt shows various system events and conditions on two Mac systems, calvisitor-10-105-163-202 and authorMacBook-Pro, including thermal and memory pressure states, location services, and network activity.
The events occur over a period of approximately 26 minutes, with some events, such as the AppleCamIn system wake call, happening simultaneously on both systems.
The log lines also indicate some errors or denied actions, such as a hashing failure in NetworkAnalyticsEngine and a denied network-outbound request by sandboxd.
